title: Rot Rush: Neon Snacklands
elevator_pitch: Build a brainrot collection on a glowing market plot, bank its passive income, and dodge the glitch ring while climbing six rarity tiers.
first_five_minutes: Claim the plot where you spawn and read the four empty collection pads.
Open the HUD shop or walk to the market; buy an affordable Common or Uncommon creature.
Watch it appear on your plot and begin generating unbanked cash each second.
Collect the balance, buy another creature, and purchase an income upgrade.
Cross the hazard ring to browse a higher-tier restock, then return to your plot.

systems.name: Plot economy
systems.details: Twelve player plots have four server-owned creature pads, unbanked passive earnings, and a persistent wallet.

systems.name: Rotating rarity market
systems.details: Three offers rotate through six original brainrots from Common to Mythic. Server checks prices and inventory.

systems.name: Progression
systems.details: Cash buys an income multiplier upgrade; rebirth trades a large balance for a permanent income bonus.

systems.name: Glitch ring
systems.details: A neon hazard circle damages players who cross carelessly between the market and the outer plots.

systems.name: HUD
systems.details: A responsive ScreenGui shows money, pending cash, income, market stock, upgrades, rebirth, and collection pads.
